newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (F to O)- Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (F to O)- Sept 9.

text.p: NOTES: ANZ Securities is standing in the market for a
period of a month from August 21. Offeror is now entitled to 91.97 percent.
OFFEROR: Suncorp Insurance and Finance, the Queensland Industry Development Corp.
TERMS: The proposed merger values Metway at A$4.65
ex-dividend. Bid was raised to A$4.80 per share on June 26.
NOTES: The offer is through a scheme of arrangement and
was subject to court, shareholder and regulatory approval.
TERMS: Increased on August 19 to A$1.05 per share cum

dividend from A$1.20 cash per share cum-dividend. On July 24 Ellingcross revised their bid to allow shareholders to retain the 3.5 cents per share dividend announced on July 19. Independent directors recommend shareholders take no action in relation to the offer. Offeror is entitled to 57.36 percent of Motors Holdings and will not proceed with compulsory acquisition. The offer has now closed and all acceptances will be returned to shareholders.
TERMS: A$2.64 cash per share and one cent per option
NOTES: The offer is conditional upon approvals from
Bank Negara Malaysia, the FIRB and offeror shareholders. Offeror is currently entitled to 78.24 percent of the issued capital of the offeree and has received approvals.
TERMS: Normandy to offer 425 of its shares for every
NOTES: North Flinders is about 50 percent owned by

Posgold Ltd, which is currently subject to a merger proposal by Normandy. Offer is conditional on successful completion of the proposed Normandy/Posgold/Gold Mine of Kalgoorlie merger which was approved by shareholders on August 16. Offeror is entitled to 55.71 percent of North Flinders' capital. Directors recommended shareholders accept the bid. Court approval for the scheme of arrangement was received on August 22.
NOTES: Directors advise shareholders not to sell their
shares pending further advice. Offeror is entitled to 19.32 percent of the offeree.
